_comment: The ONE GA4 URL allow-list (K4, harness-notes/legal-t4/MERGE.md). A query parameter not named in params (and not starting with a prefixes entry) is dropped from page_location, page_referrer, link_url and the Measurement Protocol page_location. A path segment matching seg (a credential prefix) is templated to :token. A whole path matching a paths entry is templated to that entry's as (T4-G5: the rooms invite link /rooms/join/<code> to /rooms/join/:code). Read by edge/src/ga4.d4d15ea9.ts (ga4AllowSpec) and substituted into the inline client for __SB_GA4_ALLOW__, so the client and the server scrubber share this one definition. Adding a link parameter or a path here is the only way to make it reach GA.
